name: random-letter-swap-hover
title: Random Letter Swap Hover
description: Text label whose characters flip over to an identical copy in a shuffled order, so the swap scatters across the word.

meta.interaction: Hovering the label slides letters out one at a time in random order while matching letters drop in behind them. One variant plays the swap through once; the other holds it and runs it back in reverse when the pointer leaves.
